notes.title: Tell Me Your Story - Update 1.0.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h2][b] Hey! It's us again! 

We're here to let you know that we're taking your comments on the game into account and working not only on bugs but also on puzzles - everything to make your experience with the game better and better!

So... 1.0.2 for Tell Me Your Story is now live 📢 [/b][/h2]


[b]Patch 1.0.2 includes:

Level changes

Chapter 2 / Level 32
Simplifying the pattern for players to be arranged
Added edge to suggest the orientation of pattern placement

Chapter 3 / Level 42
Macarons now have markings and decorations
Increased readability of the visuals[/b]

[h2][b]
Enjoy the game! ❤️[/b][/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1415570/Tell_Me_Your_Story/

notes.title: Demo version of Tell Me Your Story is now available on Steam!
notes.notes:
[h2][b] Good news, dear friends! We are very pleased to inform you that demo version of Tell Me Your Story is now available on Steam! Take Grandma Rose's diary and, as her granddaughter Amelia, begin a nostalgic journey through the memories of the unexceptional traveler, today! [/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768541/45851092786d6dd26047fc9beb27b7a5bece35d8.png[/img]

[h3]Tell Me Your Story is an atmospheric combination of cozy, wordless storytelling with more than 70 satisfying puzzles and riddles. The story about family relationships takes the best of both relaxing genres and is beautifully illustrated with hand-drawn graphics.

You can dive into this fantastic adventure today, thanks to the demo version!
In addition, after playing the game you can fill out a special survey about it, so we will know what you liked about it and what we can still improve![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768541/4f61c0809c07e64f6215c0d7bd0a10aea128d93a.png[/img]

[h3]The game will be released in the 2024 on Steam and Nintendo Switch, and you can add it to the wishlist now! The release date of the game will be announced at a later date, so stay tuned for more informations![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768541/df87503b06709c1dc9d8eaec24939a7f8338c9a9.gif[/img]


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1415570/Tell_Me_Your_Story/
